# 1950s Broadway audience research packet

Source Notes:

Multiple observers describe theatergoers leaving evening performances under bright marquees, with damp pavement catching reflected light from signs and taxis.

Reusable Concepts:

Dark wool overcoats, structured evening hats, visible breath in cold air, neon street reflections.

Uncertainties / Contradictions:

Some accounts emphasize formal gloves and polished shoes, while others focus more on practical winter outerwear than evening refinement.

Scene or Prompt Implications:

The street should read as post-show, cold, crowded, reflective, and lit by theatrical signage rather than broad daylight.

Unexpected Findings:

One note emphasizes the contrast between performance-venue crowds and daytime shoppers more strongly than expected.
